betterhiddenchat.persistency.off: Chat will not be persistently hid.
betterhiddenchat.notifyChatShow.on: You will be notified when the chat gets shown.
betterhiddenchat.notifyChatShow.off: You will not be notified when the chat gets shown.
betterhiddenchat.notifyAsOverlay.on: Your notification will be shown as an overlay.
betterhiddenchat.notifyAsOverlay.off: Your notification will be shown as a chat message.
betterhiddenchat.showWhileTyping.on: Chat will be shown while typing.
betterhiddenchat.showWhileTyping.off: Chat will not be shown while typing.
betterhiddenchat.help.2: Hides the chat, whilst allowing to send messages and run commands.
betterhiddenchat.help.4: ● §7§lnotifyAsOverlay§r - toggles the notification between a chat message and an overlay message. Overlay by default.
betterhiddenchat.help.5: ● §7§lnotifyChatShow§r - toggles whether to send a notification when the chat is shown. On by default.
betterhiddenchat.help.6: ● §7§lpersistency§r - keep the chat hidden the next time you open the game, if you had it hidden when you closed it. Off by default.
betterhiddenchat.help.7: ● §7§lshowWhileTyping§r - toggles whether to show the chat when typing if the chat is hidden. On by default.
betterhiddenchat.help.8: It's also possible to set a keybind through the default Minecraft controls menu to toggle chat visibility.
